name: Church Ushers
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of faithful service and stewardship in the church, exemplified by those who serve as ushers. Like the Levites who were appointed to serve in the tabernacle from thirty to fifty years old (Numbers 4:3), ushers guard the church entrance and assist the congregation, reflecting the heart of the doorkeeper who values even a day in God's courts above all else (Psalms 84:10). Their service is an act of worship done willingly to the Lord (Ephesians 6:7), involving hospitality and care for the needs of fellow believers (Romans 12:13), and supporting the spiritual oversight entrusted by the Holy Spirit to church leaders (Acts 20:28). This role embodies a watchful and dedicated ministry, akin to waiting at the gates with blessing and attentiveness (Proverbs 8:34).
